text:
My father has died.

His absence repeats itself each day

in the empty home.

I ask,

and besides absence and besides

losing the roads of this earth,

what is death?


I ask you, father, what is death?

Have you found the peace you deserved?

Did you find shelter in a new house

or do you wander, and suffer beneath the cold

of the greatest winter, of total

lovelessness?


I ask you, father, if the dead are something,

or if death is only

an immense word that contains

everything that does not exist.

translation.title: My Father Has Died...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the direct filial questions and the final definition of death as an immense word.
